1.heading:
<Product Designer />
Vibe Coding Workshop
1.subtitle: From Figma Design System to Strapi Database, complete your Side Project in 2 days
highlights: Vibe Coding to create web products

valueProposition.title: From Figma Design System to Strapi Database, complete your Side Project in 2 days

usp.title: Start from Design System, Build Design Tokens
usp.description: Learn how to convert Figma Variables into CSS Design Tokens, build a complete design system architecture, and seamlessly bridge design and development.

usp.title: Integrate Frontend & Backend Development
usp.description: Not just static websites - I'll teach you to build databases with Strapi (Headless CMS) and deploy to Zeabur cloud hosting.

usp.title: AI-Powered (Vibe Coding)
usp.description: Use Cursor + AI Agent throughout the course. You handle the logic, AI writes the code.

syllabus.title: Design System & Component Digitization

sessions.title: Figma Variables & Design Tokens Conversion
sessions.description: Understand what Design Tokens (Variables) are, learn how to export Figma Variables as JSON and standard CSS Variables. Establish a "Design Token specification" between design and code, ensuring colors, fonts, and spacing are synchronized on the development side.

sessions.title: Vibe Coding Practice: AI-Generated Storybook Component Library
sessions.description: Using the Tokens defined in the morning, guide AI through prompts to build core components like Card and Button. Automatically generate Storybook documentation and variants, creating a "functional" UI component library and building a design system component library.

syllabus.outcome: Deliverable: Develop your own Storybook design system component library and Design Tokens architecture

syllabus.title: Inject Soul & Product Launch

sessions.title: Build Product Brain (Strapi) & Data Integration
sessions.description: Launch Strapi (Headless CMS) as the product brain. Learn to define data fields (Schema), direct AI to write API integration logic, replace hardcoded dummy data with real data, enabling the interface to add and read content.

sessions.title: Cloud Deployment & Personal Feature Sprint
sessions.description: Unlock the final mile of full-stack development: Deploy GitHub code to Zeabur cloud hosting. Finally, sprint on Side Project core features (e.g., implement like or comment functionality), and with mentor assistance, graduate with your own product URL.

syllabus.outcome: Deliverable: Build a real product (MVP) with backend, interactivity, and live deployment

pricing.location: Near Taipei Main Station (Detailed location TBA)
pricing.note: Seed Launch Exclusive: 2 classes, 4-6 people per class

faq.question: Can I join if I have no coding experience?
faq.answer: Absolutely! The core of this course is teaching you to use AI (Cursor) to write code. You only need to understand design logic.

faq.question: What should I prepare?
faq.answer: A laptop with SourceTree installed, and pre-register for GitHub, Zeabur, and Cursor accounts (we'll provide a setup guide).
